Q6181.reason: WHO 2017 under-five estimates rank preterm birth complications first, ahead of pneumonia, diarrhea, and malaria.

Q9006.reason: GTD and Global Terrorism Index figures put 2017 terrorism deaths at roughly 19,000–26,000, nearest to 26,000.

Q9007.reason: UNESCO’s 2015 literacy rate for people 15 and older was about 86% and still rising; 91% is the youth rate.
